critical_code_review_comments: server.py is ~11.6k lines: continue extracting modules (governance section could be its own router).
master_govern accepts any leader name without validating against roster — acceptable per spec but note the parsed.leader is trusted verbatim.
GET /master/sections uses optional_user (public read) while POST is admin-only — correct, but consider hiding to admins if sections carry sensitive metadata.
In LLM parse block, keep a hard timeout in stream_message to avoid hanging requests on Claude latency.
seed_data_creation: None (used app_meta collection keys line_leaders, master_sections)
context_for_next_testing_agent: Master-centric governance is fully functional. BakoInfo panel is embedded in PlantRadar header via bako-info-trigger. Voice input via Web Speech is not testable in headless automation — use bako-info-input text field. Reply language follows i18n (EN reply observed when app is in EN). Event 'mikilab-govern-executed' triggers LineLeaders refresh and radar updates in real-time.
